Demonic Physiology: Evelynn is a demon, an evil spirit that feeds on human emotions. She lacks a physical form and cannot be harmed by physical weapons (unless they have magical properties). Each demon is linked to a specific emotion; in this case, Evelynn feeds on pain and agony.
Emotional Feeding: Like other demons, Evelynn can feed on a specific emotion, in her case, pain and agony. By absorbing the agony of others, Evelynn can survive for long periods. Evelynn instinctively knows how to inflict suffering.
Immortality: As long as agony and pain exist, Evelynn will exist in some form.
Shadow Magic: Evelynn can use shadows to form anything she desires, primarily to form spikes to torture her victims.
Shapeshifting: As a spirit, Evelynn can shapeshift to suit any situation, usually transforming into a form that allows her to easily seduce people.
Invisibility: Evelynn can turn into a nearly invisible shadow, visible only to the most attentive onlookers.
Razor-Sharp Body Parts: Evelynn often uses self-made razor-sharp body parts, such as claws and flails, to torture and kill the people she attacks.
Demon Shadow: Evelynn envelops herself in Demon Shadow.
Spiked Hatred: Evelynn throws a dart in the target direction, dealing damage. Evelynn unleashes a line of deadly spikes at the nearest visible enemy, dealing damage.
Seduce: She casts a curse on the victim, turning the victim into a Mazokism lover for a short time.
Whiplash: Evelynn lashes the target enemy with her whips, dealing damage. Empowered Whiplash: Evelynn lashes out at the target enemy, dealing increased damage upon completion, as well as to all enemies in her path.
Last Caress: Reveals her true form, becoming untargetable at the start of the cast and unleashing her lashes in a cone toward the target.
